items.t: Engine stalls when fuel pump fuse blows (recall)
items.job: Reroute fuel tank temperature sensor harness or replace fuel pump assembly
items.note: Free at Nissan dealers (Chevrolet dealers for City Express). Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Passenger airbag may switch off (recall)
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Airbag light from passenger seat sensor fault
items.note: Check first whether the 2013-2016 recall or retrofit applies.

items.t: A/C water leaks into the center console
items.job: Console insulator / airbag control unit service campaign
items.note: Free at a dealer if your VIN is included in Nissan's service campaign.

items.t: Wiring harness short can stop the engine (recall)
items.job: Reposition harness and add protective cover
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Steering column may come apart (recall)
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Backup camera image can be switched off (recall)
items.note: Free at the dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Tires wearing out early or cupping
CVT noise or poor operation (torque converter campaign)
items.job: Replace torque converter under Nissan campaign
items.note: Free if your VIN is in the campaign; outside it, CVT repairs can cost thousands.

items.t: CVT judder with transmission trouble codes
items.job: CVT fluid change and software update
items.note: Valve body or transmission replacement costs far more if the update doesn't fix it.

items.t: Check engine light for EVAP leak
items.job: Replace EVAP vent valve O-ring, purge valve or fuel cap

items.t: Check engine light for air flow sensor (P0101)
items.note: Follow Nissan's bulletin before replacing the sensor.

items.t: Clicking from axles when pulling away
items.job: Noise diagnosis, clean and grease axle-to-hub joint

items.t: Clunk or pop from front strut when steering
items.job: Replace front strut mounts or struts
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,450-$1,710 for strut replacement; mount-only repairs cost less.

items.t: No start after sitting in freezing weather
items.note: Covers diagnosis; parts depend on what is found.

items.t: Key won't come out or shifter stuck in Park
items.job: Adjust key interlock cable and stop lamp switch (bulletin NTB15-110a)
items.note: The bulletin calls for adjustments only, with no parts. Labor is based on YourMechanic's $95-$115 estimate for a won't-shift-from-Park check; a dealer may need longer.

items.t: Weak air conditioning in the rear seats
items.note: Cost assumes a failed blower; refrigerant or other A/C repairs cost more.

items.t: Hood flies open while driving
items.note: Windshield or hood damage is extra.

items.t: Engine vibration from driver-side mount
items.note: RepairPal lists about $700-$740 for 2013-2014 and $875-$915 for 2015-2021.

items.t: No start from low 12-volt battery
